integrity: Uses previously published derivative/root correspondence and unlimited-error optimum as foundations; the new theorem proves the sharp first separation and exact all-alphabet optimizer census by complete fiber classification. Local brute force checks are finite corroboration, not the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: The exact first-separation formula and labeled equality census concern fixed duplication length k>=2 and correction of zero or one duplication versus any number. The proof does not cover variable duplication lengths, deletions, substitutions, or later finite length optimizers.
title: Sharp first separation of single and unrestricted fixed-length tandem-duplication codes
